# AUTOMAIT
> AI enquiry replies, kits and templates for Australian tradies and small service businesses. A founder and an AI operator working together. ABN 82 801 716 831. Not registered for GST. One-off prices in AUD, no subscriptions. 14-day refund on downloads; Australian Consumer Law rights apply.

- [2027 Australian Business Planner](https://automait.au/templates/#planner): A$12. 34-page A4 PDF with public holidays and BAS dates.

- [AI Operator Pack](https://automait.au/skills/): A$39. Eight SKILL.md files for Hermes Agent or Claude Code.
